exposure: All controls created and inspected by the developer on 2026-10-12; separate from the five development families.
length_measure: Whitespace-delimited words; both variants contain the same number of words.
defect: S1 implies (10%-5%)/10%=50% relative reduction; the defective variant says 5%. The absolute reduction is correctly 5 percentage points in both.
rule: Run all three packets in fresh contexts without this key. A judge must locate and explain the relative/absolute error, preserve its identification after label swap, and not invent a substantive difference in the identical valid tie. Preserve failures and disagreement; do not count the three orientations as independent tasks or tune and retest on these same controls as held-out validation.
limitation: This directory contains one arithmetic family, now included unchanged in judge-calibration-v3 alongside three Chinese/English causal, attribution and constraint families. All 12 first Astra judgments are retained in evals/diagnostics/2026-10-12-astra-calibration; those results do not establish reliability across all dimensions, domains or languages.
